title: The real lookup misses about claude -p protected paths, Bash trailing-space rules and GitHub rulesets have eval rows naming the article that answers them
goal: Each of three real misses the kb can answer gets a row in the public lookup eval set naming the article that answers it, and packs good with that article on HEAD (a doc2query expansion of the answering fact where it packs weak): 'claude -p headless mode: can it edit files under .claude/ directory, protected paths' (F-32e0e03abedf; answered by the settings-and-scopes article's protected-path fact, packs weak), 'Claude Code Bash permission rule wildcard trailing space star matches command without arguments' (F-b28d0d79b19b; answered by the powershell-tool article's Bash trailing-space fact), 'GitHub rulesets branch protection public repository' (F-fe10582bc61f; answered by the github-branch-rules-and-auto-merge article); rag.py eval passes with the rows added; the findings themselves are closed by ST-7j6dm5wq, so this item writes no query-log file.
